description: access_groups read/delete operations (GET/DELETE /v1/access-groups/{idOrName} and GET/DELETE /v1/access-groups/{accessGroupIdOrName}/projects/{projectId}) omit the 404 the live API returns for a missing access group / project attachment, so distilled's typed union lacks NotFound on all four. The reconciler's observe step (read -> missing -> create) and the idempotent deletes branch on a typed NotFound tag; without it the 404 surfaces untyped. Add the 404 responses so the generator attaches the status-class NotFound error.
